note: Klirway, the San Marino card issuer (formerly BKN301) whose Mastercard credit cards the republic's banks, Banca di San Marino among them, offer: its information sheet for individual credit cards (published February 2026), read in full. Each card is a charge card ('carta a saldo'): the month's statement is debited to the holder's current account in one payment, without interest, on the 15th of the following month. The yearly fee is the sheet's maximum for each card (Standard 30 euros, Gold 130, World Elite metal 350, ceramic 450); each bank sets its own figure within it, which the sheet doesn't give, so the maximum is written. A cash advance costs 4% of the sum in euros (the ATM owner's own charge isn't modelled); spending in another currency carries Klirway's 1.4% (the card network's own 0% to 0.58% on top, varying by country, isn't modelled; the sheet caps the two together at 2%). The sheet charges no late-payment interest or fee ('Non previsti'). The paper statement's 3 euros a month, the optional extra credit lines and the insurance aren't written. Wave 4 (30 October 2026): no issuer was added. Banca Agricola Commerciale's and Cassa di Risparmio's credit cards are Klirway's (BKN301's), whose sheet is read here; Banca Sammarinese di Investimento issues its own Consumer credit card, but its transparency and documents pages list no information sheet for it.
